 Written by Rounak Khare , ETMarkets.com | Nov 16, 2026, 05:35:50 PM IST 1 / 5 Fresh Peaks
 Benchmark Sensex climbed 512 points to settle at 82,104 on Monday. Riding the market rally, four stocks from the BSE 100 index hit fresh 52-week highs, touching their highest price levels in the past 12 months. A 52-week high represents the highest price at which a stock has traded over the last year and may indicate heightened market activity and investor interest.
 iStock 2 / 5 Eternal
 New 52-week high: Rs 372.45 | CMP: Rs 370.85. In the last month, the stock gained about 14%.
 THE ECONOMIC TIMES 3 / 5 The Federal Bank
 New 52-week high: Rs 368.80 | CMP: Rs 362. In the last month, the stock gained about 10%.
 Agencies 4 / 5 Kotak Mahindra Bank
 New 52-week high: Rs 497.90 | CMP: Rs 493.20. In the last month, the stock gained about 11%.
 Agencies 5 / 5 Punjab National Bank
 New 52-week high: Rs 146.85 | CMP: Rs 144.40. In the last month, the stock declined about 24%.
